'''Jafar Zafarani''' ({{langx|fa|جعفر زعفرانی}}) is an Iranian mathematician. A professor at the [[University of Isfahan]] and chancellor at [[Sheikhbahaee University]], Zafarani's research interests include [[functional analysis]] and [[nonlinear functional analysis]]. Zafarani obtained his [[BSc]] in Mathematics at the [[University of Tehran]] in 1969 and completed his [[D.Sc.]] at the [[University of Liège]], [[Belgium]] in 1974. He served as president of the [[Iranian Mathematical Society]] from 1989 to 1991.<ref>[http://sciold.ui.ac.ir/~jzaf/Experience/ Professional Experience] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200813101532/http://sciold.ui.ac.ir/~jzaf/Experience/ |date=2020-08-13 }}, Zafarani's webpage</ref>

== Professional Experience ==
Associate editor of the Journal  of  Sciences,  Islamic Republic of
Iran. <br/>
Associate editor of the Journal of Optimization, Theory and Applications. <br />
Associate editor of the Journal of Nonlinear and Variational Analysis. <br />
President at Sheikhbahaee University <br />
